Range

Range sliders let users select a value from a continuous range. They are ideal for volume, brightness, price filters, and similar controls.

Basic Range

A simple range slider with min, max, and step values.

50
HTML
<input type="range" class="zak-range" min="0" max="100" value="50">

Range with Labels

Display the current value and min/max labels.

$0 $500
Selected: $150
HTML
<div class="zak-range-labels">
  <span class="zak-range-label-min">$0</span>
  <input type="range" class="zak-range" min="0" max="500" value="150"
    oninput="document.getElementById('val').textContent = '$' + this.value">
  <span class="zak-range-label-max">$500</span>
</div>
<span class="zak-form-text">Selected: <strong id="val">$150</strong></span>

With Marks / Steps

Display step marks along the range track.

012345
3 stars
HTML
<input type="range" class="zak-range zak-range-steps" min="0" max="5" step="1" value="3">
<div class="zak-range-marks">
  <span>0</span><span>1</span><span>2</span><span>3</span><span>4</span><span>5</span>
</div>

Custom Styled

Range with color customization.

HTML
<input type="range" class="zak-range zak-range-primary" min="0" max="100" value="60">
<input type="range" class="zak-range zak-range-success" min="0" max="100" value="75">
<input type="range" class="zak-range zak-range-danger" min="0" max="100" value="30">
<input type="range" class="zak-range zak-range-warning" min="0" max="100" value="45">

Disabled

Non-interactive disabled state.

HTML
<input type="range" class="zak-range" min="0" max="100" value="50" disabled>

JS Demo

Interactive range with live value display and progress fill.

70%
HTML + JS
<div class="zak-input-group">
  <span class="zak-input-group-text">☀</span>
  <input type="range" class="zak-range zak-range-primary" min="0" max="100" value="70"
    oninput="document.getElementById('val').textContent = this.value + '%'">
  <span class="zak-input-group-text" id="val">70%</span>
</div>

CSS Classes Reference

ClassDescription
.zak-rangeBase range slider
.zak-range-stepsWith step marks
.zak-range-primaryPrimary color
.zak-range-successSuccess color
.zak-range-dangerDanger color
.zak-range-warningWarning color
.zak-range-labelsContainer with min/max labels
.zak-range-marksStep marks display

Accessibility

  • Every range input must have an associated <label>.
  • Use aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-valuenow for custom ranges.
  • Provide an aria-label or visible label to describe the control.
  • Ensure keyboard support: arrow keys to increment/decrement.
  • Announce value changes to screen readers with aria-live regions.
